title: Layout rhythm

domain.defaultBehavior: normal (factor 1) — byte-identical to the pre-rhythm cascade in every vertical, because the DS floor already resolves --ds-rhythm-effective-scale to 1

compatibility: additive, unset-to-rollback. ORTHOGONAL to density.mode by construction and never a second spelling of it: density scales control SIZES through --ds-density-effective-scale, rhythm scales the LAYOUT RELATIONSHIPS between controls (gap, layout padding) through --ds-rhythm-effective-scale. A chain carrying both factors is correct rather than double-scaled — the control keeps its density size while the room around it breathes. Rhythm is applied at the PRESET rungs, never at a consume site, so a consumer numeric gap stays exact geometry exactly as it does under density; and it never reaches a control height, touch target or icon box, which is what keeps the coarse-pointer touch floors intact by construction rather than by clamping. The 0.8-1.25 envelope is enforced in the derived channel, so it binds the compiler artifact, the BrandTheme lowering and a raw tokenOverride alike.

calibration.evidenceKindLabellingRule: Every one of the eight artifacts proves BOTH a computed delta and an exact restore; each is a three-phase both-arm run. evidenceKind names the ROLE the receipt is claimed for, not the only thing its artifact contains: the four tight receipts are claimed as static-db-computed-parity and the four airy receipts as exact-restore. A reader who wants the other half of either receipt will find it in the same artifact.

knownDefects.finding: Eight block-size fallbacks multiplied 415px by rhythm and therefore changed panel capacity instead of spacing.
knownDefects.remediation: The private socket --_ds-dashboard-panel-block-size survives with the byte-exact 415px fallback and reads no rhythm channel.

knownDefects.finding: appearanceAdvancedToVariables filters raw tokenOverrides on the --ds- prefix and an entry-count cap only, with no name allowlist, so a hand-built TenantAppearanceAdvanced payload can write --ds-rhythm-scale directly and escape the tight/normal/airy vocabulary. Two productive callers reach it unvalidated: infrastructure/runtime/bootstrap/facade/react/provider/index.tsx and infrastructure/compilers/runtime/tenant-css/visual-config/index.ts.
knownDefects.boundedBy: The 0.8-1.25 envelope still holds, because the clamp lives in --ds-rhythm-effective-scale in default.css and not in the compiler. A raw override can pick an arbitrary in-envelope factor; it cannot leave the envelope.
knownDefects.remediation: Requires owner adjudication: enforcing the exact allowlist at that site would drop every --ds- name outside the list on the legacy compat path, which is far wider than this control.

knownDefects.finding: The static BrandTheme lowering read the rhythm factor table with a bare bracket index and emitted String(factor) with no own-property guard, no numeric guard and no clamp. BrandTheme is typed but arrives as plain JSON, so the type erases: surfaces.rhythm='toString' emitted a function body and {toString:()=>'tight'} coerced to 0.85, while the DB path rejected both at document validation.
knownDefects.remediation: Own-property, typeof-number and Number.isFinite guards plus a clamp through TENANT_THEME_RHYTHM_SCALE_BOUNDS, mirroring the DB lowering exactly.
knownDefects.subsequentFinding: THE MIRROR WAS ASSERTED, NOT MADE. Fixing the static lowering did not fix the DB lowering: appearanceGeneralToVariables in infrastructure/compilers/kernel/runtime/appearance/index.ts still read TENANT_THEME_RHYTHM_FACTORS[general.rhythm] with a bare bracket index. That function is EXPORTED and reachable without validateTenantThemeDocument through the legacy TenantConfig.appearance compat path, so an inherited member name resolved to a function, `factor != null` passed, clampValue coerced it through Math.min/Math.max to NaN, and setVar wrote the literal text NaN into --ds-rhythm-scale -- which makes clamp(0.8, var(--ds-rhythm-scale, 1), 1.25) invalid at computed-value time for every consumer of the effective channel. The existing parity test could not see this: its DB arm consulted validateTenantThemeDocument and returned early, so it compared a COMPILER against a VALIDATOR.
knownDefects.subsequentRemediation: The own-property + typeof-number + Number.isFinite guard is now mirrored into appearanceGeneralToVariables, and the parity test gained a COMPILER-versus-COMPILER block that drives compileBrandTheme and appearanceGeneralToVariables on the same valid/absent/hostile matrix with no schema on either side, plus a counterfactual that reproduces the unguarded arithmetic and proves it really did emit 'NaN' while both guarded lowerings refuse the same input.

dischargedContractQuestions.outcome: Discharged and widened. The census also watches the unclamped --ds-rhythm-scale spelling, classifies physical inline sides as forbidden, and closes over transitive var() carriers so a single rename cannot launder a forbidden read.

dischargedContractQuestions.question: Adjudicate whether border-radius is inside the declared 'border remains fixed' negative control. Rhythm reaches border-radius in eight declarations through the nested-radius idiom (--ds-card-padding-current to --_ds-card-nest-radius and --_surface-radius-current) in runtime/engines/modern/skin/card.css, presentation/components/semantic-surface.css and presentation/components/skin/card-compounds.css. A nested radius derived from padding arguably must move with padding to stay concentric; the contract arguably says it must not move at all. The gate records these as indirectUnclassified and stays green pending the ruling.
dischargedContractQuestions.outcome: Discharged by owner ruling, then RE-ADJUDICATED when the first encoding was found to license the ruling's own counterexample. spacing.rhythm does not govern visual/outer radius. It may affect ONLY an INTERNAL DESCENDANT radius whose sole purpose is concentric geometry inside a parent with rhythm-scaled padding. It must not affect a component's own/outer border-radius, EVEN WHEN THAT COMPONENT CAN BE NESTED. A direct rhythm radius, a generic carrier and an outer-radius change all fail. The gate no longer records an unblocking indirectUnclassified bucket -- that bucket now fails the gate.
dischargedContractQuestions.evidence: packages/core/scripts/tokens/spacing-rhythm-contract-gate/index.mjs classifies DERIVED_CONCENTRIC_GEOMETRY structurally in SIX clauses and discovers the concentric channel set from the corpus rather than naming it: (a) internal/private channel, (b) radius-semantic, (c) derives-not-scales, (d) demonstrably contained -- the SELECTOR must prove the subject sits inside another element through a descendant or child combinator, so a bare compound leaning on inheritance and a sibling combinator both fail, (e) not the subject's own root -- the subject compound must carry no [data-part='root'] marker and must not repeat an ancestor's class, and (f) publishes for descendants not for self -- a private channel loses the allowance when a border-radius under the SAME selector drinks from it. 49 mutation drills in the sibling test, including inner/outer mutation PAIRS for (d), (e) and (f) and a counterfactual control on the exact fixture whose verdict the ruling flipped.

mechanizedRuling.residualOwnerQuestionResolved: The first encoding read 'internal' as 'privately named' when the ruling means 'inner geometry', and so licensed `.ds-semantic-surface`'s own border-radius through the re-published `--_surface-radius-current` carrier. The owner resolved the flagged question in favour of the stricter reading and directed that the grammar fail direct, outer and generic carriers. Clauses (d), (e) and (f) mechanize that; the source was corrected in the same packet.
retiredAtSource: presentation/components/semantic-surface.css: the `--_surface-radius-current` carrier is deleted and `.ds-semantic-surface` paints the role radius unconditionally (FORBIDDEN_GENERIC_RADIUS_CARRIER + FORBIDDEN_OUTER_RADIUS).

presentation/components/semantic-surface.css: `.ds-semantic-surface .ds-semantic-surface` subtracts the nest inset from the ROLE radius instead of from a rhythm carrier (FORBIDDEN_OUTER_RADIUS -- a nested instance is still the component's own root).
presentation/components/skin/card-compounds.css: the `.rottay-card-header` border-radius declaration is removed; its bare compound proved no containment (FORBIDDEN_OUTER_RADIUS).
runtime/engines/modern/skin/card.css: a nested card root keeps its own resolved corner instead of deriving from the parent body's nest radius (FORBIDDEN_OUTER_RADIUS).
mechanizedRuling.stillLicensed: Only the Card body's `--_ds-card-nest-radius` producer and the two genuinely inner parts of that rhythm-padded body -- the header zone and the actions zone -- whose selectors prove containment and whose subjects are parts rather than component roots.
mechanizedRuling.counterfactualUnchanged: Classic and Rustic are byte-identical: neither engine ever published `--_ds-card-nest-radius`, so every retired site resolved to exactly the value it now states literally. No Classic or Rustic file was edited.
mechanizedRuling.openForSightedReview: The retired visual intent -- a panel/well nested in a Card reading as RELATED to the card corner rather than as a second unrelated rounded rectangle -- is now unimplemented. It is recorded here rather than smuggled back through a radius. If the intent is still wanted it needs a mechanism that is not spacing.rhythm, and it needs sighted adjudication.

dischargedContractQuestions.question: Prove the computed 0.85/1/1.2 gap deltas, monotonicity and exact restore in a browser. Every result so far is authored-source and compiler-output evidence only.
dischargedContractQuestions.outcome: Discharged by a real Chromium run, not by source reading. 8 scenarios (primitive/layout/{flex,grid,stack,space} x {tight,airy}), each measuring BOTH ingress doors on ONE scene. Preset gap 15px -> 12.75px at tight (x0.85) and 15px -> 18px at airy (x1.2), exact and monotonic (12.75 < 15 < 18); the numeric-gap counterpart stayed 8px in all 16 arm-rows; --ds-rhythm-scale moved 1 -> 0.85 / 1 -> 1.2 and --ds-rhythm-effective-scale carried the same clamp on both arms. restore.exact = true and negativeControls.held = true on every arm of every scenario, and ingressEquivalence reported 0 differing rows in all 8. Every run is self-check harness-live; no run is harness-suspect.

measuredDefectsFound: The DB ingress arm was bound to compileAppearanceVariables, a symbol absent from every published entrypoint and retired from the provider. The productive DB door is compileTenantThemeConfig; the arm now loads it from the published @rottay/design-system/server subpath and RETIRED_DB_COMPILER_EXPORTS makes a rebind a load-time throw.

roster fixture button-modern-md required the selector .rottay-button.rottay-button--modern[data-part='trigger'], which commit cb1e3645f rekeyed to [data-variant]. Every run since had WITHHELD all button readings, so control-height/touch-target/icon-size were silently unmeasured.

The inline restore left an empty style="" attribute on documentElement that the baseline never had, so the DB arm could not restore exactly. planInlinePhase now observes the ATTRIBUTE before the write and removes it when it introduced it.

The causal freshness collector passed manifest sourceBindings straight to a file hasher, so a directory binding crashed the run (EISDIR) and a path:lineRange locator read as a vanished file. It now normalises path#symbol and path:1371-1451 alike, hashes only regular files, and still throws on a path-shaped binding that does not exist.
